name: Moldable
notes: Personal software factory: build and reshape apps on a Mac by asking, stream them to an iPhone, and chat with bots that run tasks. Local-first with end-to-end encryption; a developer-leaning product, so on the board as a stretch product. Requested via the form (issue #158).

access.price: Free to download; site says free with a ChatGPT subscription; 1 GB Drive sync free
